//: Copy-paste detection (jscpd, token-based Rabin-Karp). Run it with:
CI runs the same command, so the `threshold` below is a real gate: duplication cannot
grow past it. Lower it when a refactor brings the number down; raising it needs a reason
in the commit, the same rule the coverage floor follows.
min-lines 10 / min-tokens 60 is deliberately not sensitive: below that it reports every
`match` arm and every three-line builder, which is noise rather than duplication. What it
does catch at this setting has been worth catching — five copies of a Braille spinner
table, two identical dtype/shape span builders, the same unsafe HDF5 buffer handoff in two
filters, and a 40-line render tail (rect clamping included) in two screen renderers.
Tests are excluded: a test's whole job is to spell the case out, and near-identical
fixtures are usually clearer than a parameterised helper.
The threshold sits just above the measurement (0.78% at the time of writing), not at a
